div.head: Northu 62
div.ab: Gif he þonne on ðam unrihte geendige, þolige he clænes legeres ⁊ Godes mildse.
Gif he þonne on ðam unrihte geendige, þolige he clænes legeres and Godes mildse.
If, however, he dies in that sin, he is to forfeit Christian burial and God's mercy.
Yet if he dies in that sin, he is to be deprived of Christian burial and God's mercy.
Wenn er dagegen in diesem Unrecht endet, verliere er ehrliches Grab und Gottes Gnade.
If, however, he ends [his life] in that wrong, let him lose burial in consecrated ground and God's mercy.
div.note: Some of Liebermann’s notes here are cut off in the gutter of the scan used, and are still to be completed.
The strokes over the e of ‘géendige’ in D are only to mark syllable division. Liebermann compares I Eg.
